about: An application without the network (docs/adr/0030-installing-applications.mdx, decision 8): sample/RemoteImageProbe.tsx as an installed version whose account granted it nothing (OXYOS_APP_ORIGIN installed, no capabilities, as the session launches it). Its remote images are refused before any request, each failing once with the reason, never a silent blank; its prefetches are refused the same way; the store, which would answer them, is asked nothing.
